acf.s099_h2:
Your route to the
Greece Golden Visa
acf.s101_p: The project is a hotel converted into apartments.
acf.s103_p: The change-of-use model is what places the project at the reduced €250,000 Greece Golden Visa investment level.
acf.s105_p: The permit runs for 5 years and is renewable in 5-year periods for as long as you continue to own the qualifying property.
acf.s106_p: The Golden Visa is a Greek residence permit, not EU citizenship; the right to live freely in other EU countries arises only once you naturalize.
acf.s108_p: Own an apartment at Kastella Bay and open a route to a Greek residence permit for your whole family
acf.s111_h3: Visa-free travel in the Schengen Area
acf.s112_li: Travel visa-free across the Schengen Area, subject to the limit of 90 days in any 180-day period.
acf.s116_li: You can live, study, and do business in Greece with the rights of a residence permit holder.
acf.s120_li: You do not need to live in Greece to keep the permit
acf.s124_li: The permit runs for 5 years and is renewable in 5-year periods for as long as you continue to own the qualifying property.
acf.s127_p: Once you have completed the period of lawful residence required by Greek law, you can look at the route to Greek citizenship.
acf.s129_p: Naturalization is a separate step, with its own conditions on physical residence, language, integration, and official assessment.
acf.s131_p: EU citizenship rights, including the right to live and work in EU member states, arise only after naturalization is granted.
